title: How would you feel without {product}? A 4-minute research survey
description: A short research survey for active users of {product}. Your answers show the {team} who {product} is essential for, and why.
audience: People who have used {product} at least twice in the last 2 weeks
purpose: Decide whether {product} has product-market fit (40 % or more 'Very disappointed') and which user segment and benefit to focus on next

welcome.title: How would you feel without {product}?
welcome.description:
We're the {team} at {company}. We're learning who gets the most from {product} and why, so we can focus on what matters to people like you.
• For anyone who has used {product} in the last 2 weeks
• Takes about 4 minutes
• Anonymous: only the {team} sees answers, in summary
• Taking part is voluntary; you can stop at any time
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you, that's everything
thank_you.description: Your answers go straight into our product plan. We'll share a summary of what we learned within a month of {date}. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: How many times have you used {product} in the last 2 weeks?

jumps.when: Q1 is 'Not at all' or Q1 is 'Once'

questions.label: How would you feel if you could no longer use {product}?
Which of these words describe {product} for you? Select up to three.
What is the main benefit you get from {product}?
If {product} were no longer available, what would you most likely use instead?
options: A similar product from another company

questions.label: Have you recommended {product} to anyone in the last 3 months?
How could we improve {product} to better meet your needs?
Which best describes how you use {product}?
questions.description: So we can see which kinds of users find {product} essential.

questions.label: How many people work at your organisation?
questions.description: So we can compare answers across organisation sizes.
